error_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
sign_out_everywhere_hint: Ends your sessions on every phone, tablet and browser, including this one. It also stops your app keys and calendar addresses.
sign_in_password_for_keys: Sign in with your password to create keys. A PIN on a shared device cannot make keys, app connections or calendar addresses.
setup_intro: Create the first account. It will be an admin; you can add everyone else afterwards.
setup_code_hint: Printed in the server log when FamilyOS starts, and saved as setup-code in the data folder.
setup_code_wrong: The setup code is not correct. Copy it again from the server log.

login_pin_locked_other: Too many wrong PINs. Try again in {{count}} minutes.
login_locked_one: Too many wrong attempts. Try again in {{count}} minute.
login_locked_other: Too many wrong attempts. Try again in {{count}} minutes.
login_limited_one: Too many tries from this device. Wait {{count}} minute and try again.
login_limited_other: Too many tries from this device. Wait {{count}} minutes and try again.

home_sentence_needs_plan_one: {{greeting}}, {{name}}. **{{count}} thing needs you**, {{plan}} on the plan.
home_sentence_needs_plan_other: {{greeting}}, {{name}}. **{{count}} things need you**, {{plan}} on the plan.
home_sentence_needs_plan_last_one: {{greeting}}, {{name}}. **{{count}} thing needs you**, {{plan}} on the plan, {{title}} tonight.

home_sentence_clear_plan: {{greeting}}, {{name}}. Nothing needs you, {{plan}} on the plan.
home_sentence_clear_plan_last: {{greeting}}, {{name}}. Nothing needs you, {{plan}} on the plan, {{title}} tonight.

home_evening_text_other: {{count}} things were on the plan today. Tomorrow: {{tomorrow}} on the plan.

home_quiet_text_family: Nothing is on the calendar today.
home_quiet_text_week_family: Nothing is on the calendar today or in the coming week.
today_next_up_error: Could not save whose next thing to show. Try again.

home_step_people: Add the people in your family
home_step_people_text: Each person gets a colour, and a PIN on the family tablet if they want one
home_step_ai_text: So a shared photo of a flyer becomes a suggestion you approve
members_name_twin: Someone in the family is already called {{name}}. Add anyway?
members_name_twin_save: Someone in the family is already called {{name}}. Save anyway?
login_untrusted: Signing in with a PIN works only on family devices. An admin can turn this device into a family device after signing in.
devices_this_untrusted: This device is not a family device.
devices_forget: Stop using this device as a family device
members_pin_hint: PINs work only on family devices.
setup_shared_device: This device is shared at home (people with a PIN can sign in here)
feature_off_title: {{name}} is switched off for the family
feature_off_hint: Someone who manages extensions can switch it on again in Settings → Extensions. Nothing in it was deleted.
feature_off_hint_manage: Switch it on again in Settings → Extensions. Nothing in it was deleted.
no_access_title: This page is for people who may use {{name}}
no_access_title_unnamed: This page is for people who have been given access to it
no_access_hint: Someone who manages the family's roles can give you access if you need it.
not_found_hint: Check the address, or go back to Today.
not_installed_hint_manage: You can install it in Settings → Extensions. Anything it kept before is still there.
region_locale_hint: Pick your region, or type a tag such as en-GB. It sets the order of dates, the marks in numbers and money; day and month names stay in your language.
region_locale_invalid: This is not a valid language tag. Try something like en-GB.
setup_family_name_hint: How you say it, for example "The Novaks". It shows on the sign-in page and on your displays. You can change it later in Settings.
family_name_hint: Shown on the sign-in page, on displays and in messages to the family. Leave it empty for none.
telegram_linked_family: Linked to {{family}} as {{name}}. Write to me to ask the assistant; forward messages or send photos and documents to send them to Quick add.
setup_region: Dates and times will look like this: {{preview}}.
extensions_intro: What FamilyOS does for your family. Install more, or switch one off for everyone.
extensions_available_none: Everything that comes with FamilyOS is installed.
extensions_data_kept: Switching one off hides it and stops it for everyone. Uninstalling removes it when FamilyOS restarts. Nothing is deleted either way: everything is back as it was when you turn it on or install it again.
extensions_status_pending_uninstall: Leaves when FamilyOS restarts. Its data is kept.
extensions_status_refused: Left out: this version cannot run on this FamilyOS.
extensions_status_failed: Left out: it could not start.
extensions_restart_needed: Changes take effect when FamilyOS restarts. It takes a few seconds, and open screens catch up by themselves.
extensions_restarting_hint: This page opens again by itself in a moment.
extensions_restart_slow: It is taking longer than usual
extensions_restart_slow_hint: If FamilyOS does not come back, check that the server is running, then reload.
extensions_uninstall_hint: {{name}} leaves when FamilyOS restarts. Its data is kept. After the restart you find it under Available on this page, and installing it again brings everything back as it was. No internet is needed.
extensions_installed_toast: {{name}} installs when FamilyOS restarts. Undo cancels it.
extensions_uninstalled_toast: {{name}} leaves when FamilyOS restarts. Undo keeps it.
extensions_asked_install: {{who}} asked to install at {{when}} · waiting for a restart
extensions_asked_uninstall: {{who}} asked to uninstall at {{when}} · waiting for a restart. Its data is kept.
extensions_asked_update: {{who}} asked to update at {{when}} · waiting for a restart
extensions_restart_hint: These changes take effect. It takes a few seconds, and open screens catch up by themselves.
extensions_reach_inside_hint: It connects to nothing on the internet.
extensions_reach_user_urls: Opens web addresses you give it
extensions_reach_user_urls_hint: Only addresses someone in the family adds, such as a calendar link.
extensions_reach_local_hint: Only an address someone allows, such as a server at home.
extensions_reach_capabilities_hint: Choose who has them in Roles.
extensions_works_with_hint: When that is installed too; it is not needed.
extensions_error_missing: It needs {{name}}, which this server does not have.
extensions_found_none: Nothing new: you have the newest of every extension FamilyOS publishes.
extensions_find_unreachable: The FamilyOS index could not be reached. Check this server's internet connection, then look again.
extensions_find_missing: FamilyOS has not published its list of extensions yet, so there is nothing to download. What comes with FamilyOS is under Available and installs without the internet.
extensions_find_unsigned: The index is not signed by FamilyOS, so nothing in it is offered.
extensions_find_invalid: The index is not one this version of FamilyOS can read. Updating FamilyOS may help.
extensions_find_failed: Looking did not work. The server's log says why.
extensions_reach_data: Its data stays when you uninstall it, and comes back when you install it again.
extensions_found_official_reach_hint: It is in the index FamilyOS signs, which also says what it reaches. The download is checked against that before you can install it.
extensions_download_reach_changed: The package reaches something other than the index said, so it was not used. Look for more again later.
extensions_download_hint: It comes from the FamilyOS index and is checked like a file before you install it.
extensions_found_official_hint: It is in the index FamilyOS signs. Once it is downloaded you see what it reaches, then choose Install.
extensions_download_unreachable: It could not be downloaded. Try again.
extensions_download_missing: The index lists this version, but its file is not online. Try again later.
extensions_download_mismatch: What arrived is not the file the index describes, so it was not used. Try again.
extensions_download_gone: The index no longer lists this version. Look for more again.
extensions_download_failed: The download did not work. The server's log says why.
extensions_signed_hint: FamilyOS checked that it comes from its makers and was not changed since. Key {{keyId}}
extensions_file_unsigned: FamilyOS cannot confirm who made this file, so it does not install it. Only extensions signed by FamilyOS can be installed.
extensions_file_incompatible: This extension is made for another version of FamilyOS.
extensions_file_older: This file holds an older version. FamilyOS already has {{version}}.
extensions_file_invalid: This is not an extension file FamilyOS can read, or it was changed after it was made.
extensions_file_gone: The file is no longer waiting on the server. Add it again.
extensions_file_untrusted_key: It is signed with the key {{keyId}}, which this FamilyOS does not trust.
extensions_file_signature_mismatch: Its signature does not match what it holds: it was changed after it was signed.
extensions_file_changed: {{path}} was changed after it was signed.
extensions_file_unlisted: {{path}} was added after it was signed.
extensions_file_unsafe_path: It holds a file outside its own folder: {{path}}
extensions_file_not_a_file: It holds a link or something else that is not a file: {{path}}
extensions_file_limit: An extension file can be at most {{limitMb}} MB.
extensions_file_unpacked_limit: Unpacked, it would take more than {{limitMb}} MB.
extensions_file_sdk: It needs FamilyOS platform {{needs}}; this FamilyOS is {{has}}.
extensions_file_platform: It was made for FamilyOS platform {{built}}; this FamilyOS is {{has}}.
extensions_file_reserved: Its name, {{id}}, belongs to FamilyOS itself.
extensions_problem_no_package: This server does not have its package.
extensions_problem_package_refused: Its file failed FamilyOS's check: it was changed, or it is not signed with a key this FamilyOS trusts.
extensions_problem_load_failed: Its code could not be loaded.
extensions_problem_newer_data: A newer version of it already changed your data. Install that version again.
extensions_problem_migration_order: This version cannot take over the data another version left.
extensions_problem_sdk: It needs FamilyOS platform {{needs}}; this FamilyOS is {{has}}.
extensions_problem_dependency_refused: It needs {{name}}, which is left out too.
extensions_problem_name_clash: Its name or its tables clash with FamilyOS or another extension.
extensions_problem_invalid: The package is faulty: what it says it does and its code disagree.
ai_switch_main_hint: When off, nothing is sent to any model. Shared items are kept unread.
ai_privacy: Shared items are sent only to the AI services you add here. Their keys are kept locked on this server.
ai_privacy_files_hint: Photos are sent without their location or other metadata. When off, only text is read.
ai_privacy_people_hint: Lets the AI suggest who an event or task is for. When off, it sees no names and assigns nobody.
ai_privacy_voice_hint: Voice notes are turned into text by the speech-to-text model. When off, they are kept but not read.
ai_privacy_voice_openrouter: With OpenRouter, voice notes cannot be limited to providers that keep no data.
ai_privacy_zdr: Only providers that keep no data
ai_privacy_zdr_hint: OpenRouter only, off unless you turn it on. On: only providers that keep no data and don’t train on it; some models, including most free ones, are then unavailable. Off: any provider of the chosen model may serve it, under its own data rules. It covers reading shared items and the assistant, not voice notes or search.
ai_areas_intro: Choose which parts of FamilyOS the AI may read and make suggestions in. Everything keeps working by hand when an area is off.
ai_area_sensitive_hint: Starts off. Opening it sends this area's data to the provider you chose.
ai_area_local_hint: Local only means models on your own network. If none is set for the work, it stops; it never switches to a cloud provider.
ai_area_confirm: This area’s data will be sent to the provider you chose. With OpenRouter, it goes only to providers that keep no data while “Only providers that keep no data” is on; for speech to text, that cannot be guaranteed.
ai_provider_local_hint: Its address is on your own network.
ai_no_providers: No AI service yet. Add one to start.
ai_kind_hint_openrouter: One key for many cloud models. Costs are tracked per call.
ai_kind_hint_ollama: Runs on your own computer or server; nothing leaves your network.
ai_kind_hint_openai-compatible: Any AI service that works like OpenAI's: OpenAI itself, LM Studio, vLLM …
ai_name_hint: What you call it here, for example Home computer.
ai_base_url_hint: Where FamilyOS reaches the AI service. The address filled in usually works.
ai_api_key_keep: Leave empty to keep the current key
ai_api_key_hint: The API key is a password for the AI service, made on the service's website. It is kept locked on this server.
ai_key_dropped_on_move: The stored key is removed when the address changes. Enter it again to keep using it.
ai_roles_intro: A model is the AI that does the work. Each service offers several: faster ones answer sooner and cost less, larger ones understand more. Pick one by its name at the service.
ai_role_fast_hint: Quick, cheap steps such as sorting and short answers.
ai_role_vision_hint: Reads photos and documents. Needs a model that understands images.
ai_role_smart_hint: Understands notices and messages and writes the drafts.
ai_role_transcribe_hint: Turns voice notes into text. Works with OpenAI, Groq, OpenRouter or a self-hosted Whisper server; not with Ollama.
ai_role_embed_hint: Lets people and the assistant find things by meaning ("the paper about the boiler warranty"). Needs a search model (called an embedding model), for example nomic-embed-text on Ollama or text-embedding-3-small. Only texts from the areas the AI may read are sent.
ai_area_search_not_covered: Search does not cover this area: it needs a search model on your own network, or a model for Search above.
ai_search_error: Search stopped: the search model refused a request (a wrong key or a limit?). Check Models → Search, then change a record or set the model again.
search_placeholder: Search by meaning, e.g. the boiler warranty
search_failed: Search did not work. Try again in a moment.
ai_model_needs_any_provider: Needs “Only providers that keep no data” off
ai_model_needs_any_provider_hint: No provider of this model keeps no data, so it fails while “Only providers that keep no data” is on. Turn it off, or choose another model.
ai_limits_intro: When a limit is reached, AI pauses until next month. Leave empty for no limit.
ai_usage_none: No AI calls yet this month.
ai_activity_link_hint: Every time the AI was asked something: when, for what, which parts of FamilyOS it looked at and what it cost. Never what was said.
ai_activity_intro: Every call to the AI, newest first. This shows when and what for, never the content of your shared items or the answers.
ai_activity_none: The AI has not been used yet.
ai_activity_err_disabled: Not sent: AI is switched off for this
ai_activity_err_local_required: Not sent: this area only allows AI on your own network
ai_activity_err_limit_reached: Stopped: monthly limit or credit used up
ai_activity_err_not_configured: No AI is set up for this
ai_activity_err_data_policy: No provider met the data rules: turn off “Only providers that keep no data” or choose another model
ai_activity_err_invalid_output: The answer could not be used
ai_activity_err_output_too_long: The answer got out of hand
draft_not_installed: {{name}} is not installed: this suggestion waits until it is back.
draft_turned_off: {{name}} is turned off: this suggestion waits until it is back.
draft_failed: Adding it did not work. Check the details and try again.
draft_gone: Can no longer be done: it no longer exists
draft_may_exist: This may already be there: check before approving.
draft_may_exist_some: Some of these may already be there: check before approving.
draft_approve_confirm: Tap again to add it anyway
draft_instead_there_unnamed: Something like this is already there.
draft_approval_note: After you save, someone has to approve this.
view_only_why: Your role lets you see this. {{who}} can change what your role may do.
view_only_why_unnamed: Your role lets you see this. Someone who manages the family's roles can change what your role may do.
suggest_remove_confirm: Tap again to send for approval
role_admin_hint: Can do everything, including managing people, roles, devices and AI.
role_member_hint: An adult in the household: uses everything and approves suggestions.
role_supervised_hint: Adds to lists, ticks things off and changes what they added themselves. Changing or removing other people's things waits for someone's approval.
members_about_hint: A few words that help the AI, e.g. "9 years old, at primary school" or "Sam's partner".
members_remove_hint: They can no longer sign in: their password or PIN, sessions, app keys and Telegram link end, and their email can be used again. What they added stays.
members_err_last_admin: There must always be one admin. Make someone else an admin first.
members_err_email_taken: Another family member already uses this email.
roles_intro: What each role can do. Built-in roles cannot be changed; create your own from one of them.
roles_critical_hint: Admins only: no other role can get these.
roles_custom_intro: Start from a built-in role and turn individual things on or off. Things added later (new features) follow the role you started from.
roles_in_use: Someone still has this role. Give them another role first.
cap_sign_in_pin: Sign in with a PIN on family devices
notifications_empty: Nothing new. Things that need you will show up here.
notifications_in_app_only: Notifications appear here in the app.
quiet_hours_hint: No notifications outside the app during this time. They are still listed here.
push_test_body: If you can read this, notifications work on this device.
push_device_hint: Get notifications on this phone or computer, even when FamilyOS is closed.
push_enable: Turn on notifications on this device
push_disable: Turn off notifications on this device
push_test_sent: Test sent. It should arrive in a moment.
push_test_none: The test did not reach any device.
push_on_here: Notifications are on for this device.
push_unsupported_ios: On iPhone and iPad, notifications need the app on your Home Screen. Tap Share, choose Add to Home Screen, then open FamilyOS from there.
push_unsupported: This browser does not support notifications. Try a recent version of Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari.
push_denied: Notifications are blocked for this site. Allow them in your browser or system settings, then reload this page.
push_failed: Could not turn on notifications. Check that FamilyOS is opened with a secure address (starting with https://) and try again.
telegram_intro: Let family members ask the assistant and share to Quick add from Telegram, and get reminders and approval buttons there.
telegram_step_1: In Telegram, open a chat with @BotFather.
telegram_step_2: Send /newbot and follow the questions. Pick a name and a username that ends in "bot".
telegram_step_3: Copy the token BotFather gives you and paste it below.
telegram_step_4: Then everyone links their own account under Notifications.
telegram_token_hint: The token is the long code BotFather gives you. It is kept locked on this server and never shown again.
telegram_token_required: Paste the token BotFather gave you
telegram_state_conflict: Another instance is polling with this token. Use a separate bot for testing and development.
telegram_state_invalid_token: Telegram no longer accepts this token. Create a new one with @BotFather.
telegram_state_offline: Telegram cannot be reached right now. FamilyOS keeps trying.
telegram_state_unreadable: The token cannot be opened: the server's key file is different from when it was saved. Enter the token again.
telegram_needs_worker: Telegram only works while the FamilyOS worker is running.
telegram_privacy: Messages to the bot pass through Telegram's servers and are not end-to-end encrypted. Only share what you are comfortable sending that way.
telegram_token_invalid: Telegram does not accept this token. Check that you copied all of it.
telegram_unreachable: Telegram cannot be reached. Try again in a moment.
telegram_link_hint: Ask the assistant and share to Quick add from Telegram, and get notifications and approval buttons there.
telegram_link_steps: Open the link, or send this to the bot: /start {{code}}
telegram_link_failed: Could not create a code. Try again.
telegram_link_privacy: Messages to the bot pass through Telegram's servers.
telegram_code_wrong: This code is wrong or expired. Open FamilyOS to get a new one.
telegram_start_hint: Open FamilyOS, go to Notifications and choose Link Telegram to get your link.
telegram_unlinked: Unlinked. I will not message you any more.
telegram_file_type_unsupported: I can only add photos, PDFs and text files.
telegram_file_too_big: This file is too big. The limit is 20 MB.
telegram_inbox_off: Quick add is turned off, so I cannot add this.
telegram_not_allowed: You are not allowed to do this.
telegram_quota: The daily upload limit is reached. Try again tomorrow.
telegram_failed: Something went wrong. Please try again.
telegram_replaced: It is now a change of the one already there: approve it to apply it.
telegram_help: Write to me to ask the assistant, for example "What is on the shopping list?". Forward a message, or send a photo, voice note or document, and I will send it to Quick add. /share <text> sends typed text to Quick add. /stop unlinks this chat.
telegram_linked: Linked to FamilyOS as {{name}}. Write to me to ask the assistant; forward messages or send photos and documents to send them to Quick add.
cap_drafts_waiting: See how many suggestions are waiting
devices_display_names: Show names and colors of family members
devices_display_names_hint: Without this, calendar entries and tasks appear without who they are for, and who is home is not shown.
devices_display_names_needed: Who is home needs names. Turn on names, or this is not shown.
devices_loopback_note: This address works only on this computer. Open FamilyOS on the screen with the address the family uses at home.
devices_display_done: {{name}} is connected. The family's day appears on it in a few seconds.
devices_display_waiting: Waiting for {{name}} to answer. Keep {{address}} open on it: it connects by itself within a few seconds, also if you close this.
devices_display_not_answering: No screen is asking with the code {{code}} right now. Check that {{address}} is still open on the screen and shows this code.
devices_display_expired: The code ran out before {{name}} answered, so nothing was connected. The screen shows a new code by itself: type that one.
devices_display_bad_code: That code does not work. Check the code on the screen, or wait for a new one.
display_pair_open: On your phone, scan the QR code or open this address:
display_pair_qr: Scan to open the page that connects this screen
display_pair_waiting: Waiting for you to connect it on your phone…
display_signed_in_title: This browser is used by the family
display_signed_in_text: A display needs a browser of its own, where nobody signs in. Open this page in a private window or on the device that will be the display, or sign out of FamilyOS here.
display_empty: Nothing to show yet. An admin can choose what this screen shows: Settings → Family → Devices, then tap the screen.
notify_kind_backup_failed: A backup could not be sent off the server
notify_backup_failed_body: {{target}} did not receive the latest backup ({{code}}). Open Backups to see why.
backups_schedule_nightly: Every night at {{hour}}:00. The last {{keep}} are kept.
backups_schedule_update: Before each change to the data (an update, installing an extension). The last {{keep}} are kept.
backups_schedule_manual: Copies you make yourself stay until you remove them.
backups_run_queued: Backup started. It shows up below in a moment.
backups_reason_pre-migration: Before a change to the data
backups_secret_reminder: The server's key file (FAMOS_SECRET) unlocks the AI keys and passwords FamilyOS keeps. Backups leave it out on purpose, so a stolen backup cannot open them. Keep a copy of the file somewhere safe: on a new computer you need both a backup and this file, or saved keys must be typed again and everyone signs in again.
backups_enc_unset: Not chosen yet. Nothing is sent off this server until you choose.
backups_enc_state_passphrase: Copies are locked with a passphrase before they leave.
backups_enc_state_recipient: Copies are locked to your public key. This server cannot open them.
backups_enc_state_none: Copies leave this server without a lock.
backups_enc_why: Before a copy leaves this server, FamilyOS locks it. Only someone with the passphrase can open it: not the storage company, and not anyone who finds the file. This is called encryption.
backups_enc_why_here: Backups kept on this server stay as they are.
backups_enc_now_passphrase: Now: locked with a passphrase. Choosing again replaces it for the next copies.
backups_enc_now_recipient: Now: locked to a public key. Choosing again replaces it for the next copies.
backups_enc_now_none: Now: copies leave without a lock.
backups_enc_passphrase_what: A passphrase is a long password made of a few words. You will be asked for it when a backup is brought back, maybe years from now.
backups_enc_passphrase_hint: At least 12 characters. A few random words work well.
backups_enc_warning: Without this passphrase nobody can open the copies. Write it down and keep it away from this server.
backups_enc_written: I have written the passphrase down
backups_enc_recipient_hint: For people who already use the age tool: make a key pair on your own computer with age-keygen and paste only the public key here. Bringing a backup back needs the private key, so keep it safe.
backups_enc_none_warning: Anyone who can read the storage can read your family's data. Only choose this for storage you fully control.
backups_enc_invalid: This is not a public key FamilyOS can use. It starts with age1.
backups_enc_done_passphrase: Copies are now locked with your passphrase before they leave this server.
backups_enc_done_recipient: Copies are now locked to your public key before they leave this server.
backups_enc_done_none: Copies now leave this server without a lock.
backups_enc_keep_title: To bring a backup back you need:
backups_enc_keep_copy: a backup: on this server, or a copy elsewhere
backups_enc_keep_passphrase: the passphrase, written down and kept away from this server
backups_enc_keep_private_key: the private key, on your own computer and never on this server
backups_enc_keep_key_file: the server's key file, kept somewhere safe
backups_targets_empty: No copy elsewhere yet. Add a place to send backups to.
backups_s3_hint: Works with Amazon S3, Backblaze B2, Wasabi, MinIO and Cloudflare R2.
backups_webdav_hint: For Nextcloud, create an app password under Settings, Security, and use an address like https://cloud.example/remote.php/dav/files/anna/FamilyOS
backups_f_keep_hint: Older copies on this target are deleted after each upload.
backups_f_path_style_hint: Switch on for MinIO, Cloudflare R2 and most self-hosted storage.
backups_f_keep_secret: Leave empty to keep the saved one.
backups_target_failed: Could not save. Check the details.
backups_target_remove_hint: Files already sent stay where they are.
backups_need_encryption: Choose how copies are locked, above, before the first one is sent.
backups_enc_unset_short: Copies elsewhere wait until you choose.
backups_code_timeout: The server took too long to answer.
backups_code_http_401: The user name or password is not accepted.
backups_code_http_403: Access is refused. Check the keys and the permissions.
backups_code_http_404: The address or bucket was not found.
backups_code_http_301: The server redirected the request. Use the exact address it finally answers on.
backups_code_http_302: The server redirected the request. Use the exact address it finally answers on.
backups_code_http_307: The server redirected the request. Use the exact address it finally answers on.
backups_code_http_308: The server redirected the request. Use the exact address it finally answers on.
backups_code_unreadable: The saved passphrase or password cannot be opened: the server's key file has changed. Enter it again.
backups_code_missing_local: The backup file is gone from this server.
backups_code_bad_response: The server answered in a way FamilyOS does not understand.
backups_code_multipart_failed: The server could not put the parts together.
cap_mcp_use: Connect AI apps with their own app key
mcp_intro: Let an AI app such as Claude or your own agent read and suggest changes in FamilyOS. You approve every change it suggests.
mcp_switch_hint: Off until you turn it on. When off, no app key works.
mcp_switch_hint_on: On. Apps with an app key can connect. When off, no app key works.
mcp_turned_on: AI apps may connect for the whole family
mcp_turned_off: AI apps can no longer connect
mcp_confirm_body: This is for the whole family. An app still needs its own app key, made on this page, and every change an app suggests waits for a family member to approve it. You can turn this off again at any time.
mcp_off: AI apps cannot connect yet: an admin has to turn this on.
mcp_off_admin: AI apps cannot connect yet. Turn it on above, or start with Connect an app.
mcp_step_on_body: AI apps can connect only while this is on. It is for the whole family, and you can turn it off again on this page.
mcp_step_key: Create a key for the app
mcp_step_key_body: Each app gets its own key, like a password only for that app. You can take it back at any time.
mcp_step_copy: Copy the settings into the app
mcp_kind_claude_desktop_how: In Claude Desktop open Settings, Developer, Edit config, add this and restart Claude. The computer needs Node.js for it.
mcp_kind_claude_code_how: Run this once in a terminal.
mcp_kind_other_how: Add this where the app lists its MCP servers. Some apps ask for the address and the header one by one.
mcp_name_placeholder: e.g. Claude Desktop on my laptop
mcp_name_hint: So you know later which app uses this key.
mcp_scope_hint: Suggestions always wait for a family member to approve them. An app key never changes anything by itself.
mcp_secret_once: Copy the app key now. It is shown only once and cannot be looked up later.
mcp_none_hint: Each app gets its own key, which you can take back at any time.
mcp_howto_intro: FamilyOS speaks MCP (the Model Context Protocol) over HTTP. In an app that supports MCP servers with a custom header, add a server with this address and send the app key as a Bearer token in the Authorization header.
mcp_howto_safety: Treat an app key like a password. It sees what you see, in the areas you allow the AI to use. Revoke it here if it leaks.
mcp_howto_oauth: Apps that can only sign in with OAuth cannot connect yet.
mcp_settings_link_hint: Let apps such as Claude use the family calendar and lists, each with its own app key.
notify_auto_approval_stopped_gone: Auto-approval for “{{what}}” stopped because the person who turned it on is no longer here. Suggestions wait for a person again.
notify_auto_approval_stopped_lost_access: Auto-approval for “{{what}}” stopped because you may no longer manage it. Suggestions wait for a person again.
notify_auto_approval_stopped_cannot: Auto-approval for “{{what}}” stopped because you are no longer allowed to approve it. Suggestions wait for a person again.
auto_approval_intro: Skip the waiting for routine suggestions. When the AI suggests something from a shared message or the assistant for someone who holds the right below, it is applied at once, as if you had approved it. It shows as Approved automatically in Quick add and can be undone. Everything else still waits for a person.
auto_approval_empty: Nothing can be approved automatically yet.
auto_approval_proposer_label: Apply the AI's suggestions when they are for someone who can
email_intro: Let the family's mail reach Quick add: school notices, invitations, bills. FamilyOS reads one dedicated mailbox and turns what allowed senders send into Quick add items.
email_how_1: Use a mailbox only for this: your own domain, Fastmail, mailbox.org, a self-hosted server or Proton Bridge. Not your personal inbox.
email_how_2: Create an app password for it in the mail service's settings and enter it below. The service's help pages name its server for reading mail (IMAP), usually with port 993.
email_how_3: Forward the mails you want from Gmail, Outlook or the school portal to this address, or set a filter there.
email_how_4: Add the addresses that may send below. Mail from anyone else is left alone and only counted.
email_oauth_note: Gmail and Outlook accounts that sign in with Google or Microsoft cannot be connected directly, because they no longer accept app passwords. Forward from them instead.
email_port_hint: 993 is TLS from the start, 143 upgrades with STARTTLS. The connection is always encrypted.
email_password_hint_new: Kept locked on this server and never shown again.
email_password_hint_keep: Leave empty to keep the saved password.
email_folder_hint: Created if it does not exist.
email_test_auth_failed: The server did not accept the user name or password.
email_test_unreachable: The server cannot be reached. Check the address and the port.
email_test_tls_failed: The secure connection failed. The server's certificate was not accepted.
email_test_mailbox_missing: The mailbox to read was not found.
email_test_folder_failed: The folder for handled mail cannot be created or used.
email_test_unreadable: The saved password cannot be opened: the server's key file is different from when it was saved. Enter the password again.
email_test_error: Something went wrong talking to the server.
email_processed: {{count}} mails added to Quick add so far
email_unknown: {{count}} messages from unknown senders are waiting in the mailbox
email_refused: {{count}} messages refused (failed sender check, too big or unreadable)
email_failed: {{count}} messages could not be added and will be tried again
email_needs_worker: Mail is only read while the FamilyOS worker is running.
email_senders_intro: Only mail from these addresses is read. Choose whose Quick add each address belongs to.
email_senders_empty: No sender yet. Mail waits in the mailbox until you add one.
email_sender_member: Goes to the Quick add of
email_sender_invalid: Check the address and choose a member.
email_privacy: FamilyOS reads only plain text and allowed attachments (PDF, pictures, audio, text files). It never loads pictures or links from a mail and never shows HTML. Handled mail is moved to the folder above.
offline_waiting_hint: They are saved on this device and are sent when the connection is back.
offline_banner: Offline — showing what was last seen
languages_family_default_hint: Used for people who have not chosen their own, for notifications to them, and on family displays.
languages_install_file_hint: A language pack file (.json) made for FamilyOS. The languages guide says how to make one.
languages_install_url_hint: The web address (https://) of a language pack file.
languages_problems: {{count}} strings could not be used and show in English.
languages_bad_file: This file is not a language pack.
languages_remove_confirm: Remove {{name}}? People who use it switch to English.
languages_fetch_failed: The address could not be used: {{reason}}
setup_language_intro: FamilyOS continues in the language you pick. It becomes the family's language, and everyone can choose their own later.
setup_where_hint: Guessed from this device. Check them before you create the account: they decide what "today" is, when reminders go off and how dates look. You can change them later in Settings → Family → Language & region.
setup_time_zone_invalid: Pick a time zone from the list.
region_time_zone_hint: Decides what "today" is and when reminders go off.
appearance_styles_hint: How Today and the family display are arranged. Every style works with every color theme.
appearance_preview_hint: Only on this screen until you choose it.
appearance_install_file_hint: A theme pack file (.json) made for FamilyOS. The appearance guide says how to make one.
appearance_install_url_hint: The web address (https://) of a theme pack file.
appearance_notes_one: {{count}} value in the pack was ignored.
appearance_notes_other: {{count}} values in the pack were ignored.
appearance_bad_file: This file is not a theme pack.
appearance_remove_confirm: Remove {{name}}? People who use it switch to the family theme.

devices_display_theme_hint: Applies to this display only; it still follows the sun.
appearance_mode: Day and night on this device
appearance_mode_hint: Every theme has a light day look and a dark night look. This choice is kept on this device only.
ai_provider_managed: Set in the server's settings when FamilyOS was installed (the FAMOS_AI_… lines). Change it there and restart FamilyOS.
home_ai_missing_text: FamilyOS works without it, but with an AI provider it reads what you share (messages, photos, documents) and suggests events, tasks and shopping for you to approve. It takes a minute.
profile_change_signin: Ask an admin to change your password or PIN.
profile_change_signin_admin: Change your password or PIN in
settings_saved_as_you_go: Changes are saved as you make them.
appearance_family_elsewhere: The family default and installing themes are under
theme_intro: A style arranges Today and the displays; a theme sets the colors, corner rounding and typeface. Day and night stay each person's own choice.
theme_family_hint: for everyone who has not chosen their own
theme_style_hint: How Today and the displays are arranged.
devices_trust_hint: On a family device, people pick their name and sign in with a PIN.
discard_hint: What you typed here has not been saved.
members_signin_leave: Leave empty to keep the current sign-in.
members_signin_both: Email and password, and a PIN
members_signin_intro: An email and password work on any device, a PIN only on family devices. Give one or both.
members_signin_later: Leave these empty to add a sign-in later.
members_pin_admin_hint: Signed in with a PIN, they cannot manage people, devices or settings. For that they use the email and password.
members_pin_role_off: This role signs in with an email and password only.
my_language_hint: The language FamilyOS speaks to you in, on every device: the app, notifications and the assistant.
ai_main_model_hint: Reads shared messages, photos and documents, answers in the assistant and does quick tasks. It must understand images to read photos.
ai_per_task: Choose a different model for each task
auto_approval_short: Let routine AI suggestions apply at once instead of waiting for someone to approve them.
auto_approval_undo_note: Anything applied this way shows as Approved automatically in Quick add and can be undone.
backups_secret_short: Also keep a copy of the server's key file somewhere safe: a backup brought back on a new computer needs it to open the saved passwords and keys.
telegram_busy: I am still answering your last question. One moment.
telegram_share_empty: Write the text after the command, for example: /share Parent meeting on Thursday at 17:00
telegram_answer_failed: I could not answer that. Please try again, or ask in the app.
telegram_answer_ai_off: The assistant cannot answer right now: the AI is not set up.

devices_none_hint: Add a screen for the wall, or a tablet or phone the family shares.

devices_screen_qr_hint: Using a tablet as the screen? Scan this with its camera.
devices_shared_open_body: Open this address in its web browser:

block_greeting_hint: A greeting that says what the day holds.
block_weather_hint: The temperature and the next hours.
block_photo_hint: A family photo from the same month in another year.

block_family_hint: One line for each person: what they are doing now.

words_today: today, tonight, this morning, this afternoon, this evening
